body:
## Fix

F1. Cancel progressive response readers when streamed validation/read fails, rather than only releasing their lock. Oversized responses stop producing remaining data after rejection.
F2. Preserve original validation failure if cancellation itself fails. Add regression through public ProgressiveContentStore.cacheManifest asserting CONTENT_INTEGRITY_FAILED plus underlying stream cancellation.

## Validation

V1. Regression reproduced zero cancellation calls before fix; passes after fix.
V2. Worker: 6 progressive test files, 158 tests passed.
V3. Parent reran progressive download suite: 17 tests passed. Parent reviewed responseBytes error/cleanup paths and regression assertions.
V4. Typecheck: 0 errors, 4 existing Svelte warnings. Changed-file ESLint/Prettier and diff check passed.

## Limits

L1. Stream behavior verified using WHATWG ReadableStream in Vitest, not real Chromium network transport. Full repository suites not run locally; CI remains separate.
L2. Existing Content-Length rejection before reader acquisition remains outside this streamed-overrun fix.
title: fix(content): cancel rejected progressive response streams
